title: Dissimilar

inlines.v: DISSIMILAR, adjective [dis and similar.] Unlike, either in nature, properties or external form; not similar; not having the resemblance of; heterogeneous. Newton denominates dissimilar the rays of light of different refrangibility. The tempers of men are as dissimilar as their features.
